pair_color_invariants.waiting_rule: Untouched exterior pair or Breaker-hit pair; unmatched entry commits by a reserved reply.

proof_contract: All live targets have an exterior pair or at least two pristine reserved cells. Every transition retains old unblocked pair protection and installs new unblocked pairs only inside the previous pristine domain; child domains strictly shrink. Every commitment covers all full live targets. The pair invariant prevents completion on every Maker claim, including the final legal claim.
response_rule: While a phase domain is pristine, take a fresh exterior mate when required and keep waiting. A first reserved entry or unmatched exterior move uses its actual reserved reply and listed continuation. After a matching commitment take a fresh mate if required, otherwise the lexicographically least fresh physical cell (x, then y), if any. No waiting-phase filler, pass, or virtual physical claim is used.
scope: Complete physical Breaker defense only at the exact Maker-to-move N32 32+32 state. No earlier-state loss, empty-board result, board-size bound, or novelty claim follows.
